diff --git a/client.py b/client.py
index 94f2650..fed5f03 100644
--- a/client.py
+++ b/client.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def save(transport, display_name):
-    return transport.put("/settings", {"display_name": display_name})
+    return transport.put("/settings", {"display_name": display_name.strip()})
diff --git a/tests/test_client.py b/tests/test_client.py
index 0f4b422..1092a98 100644
--- a/tests/test_client.py
+++ b/tests/test_client.py
@@ -21,3 +21,11 @@ class ClientTests(unittest.TestCase):
         transport = MemoryTransport()
         save(transport, "")
         self.assertEqual(transport.request, ("/settings", {"display_name": ""}))
+
+    def test_normalized_requests(self):
+        for value, expected in [("  Ada  ", "Ada"), ("Ada Lovelace", "Ada Lovelace"),
+                                (" \t\n", ""), ("\u00a0Ada\u3000", "Ada")]:
+            with self.subTest(value=value):
+                transport = MemoryTransport()
+                save(transport, value)
+                self.assertEqual(transport.request, ("/settings", {"display_name": expected}))
